'''Georg August Nöbeling''' (12 November 1907 – 16 February 2008) was a German [[mathematician]].

== Education and career ==
Born and raised in [[Lüdenscheid]], Nöbeling studied [[mathematics]] and [[physics]] at [[University of Göttingen]] between 1927 and 1929 and [[University of Vienna]], where he was a student of [[Karl Menger]] and received his PhD in 1931 on a generalization of the [[Inductive dimension|embedding theorem]], which for one special case can be visualized by the [[Menger sponge]].<ref>Karl Sigmund:[http://www.oemg.ac.at/Tagungen/2001/KuehlerAbschied.pdf "Kühler Abschied von Europa" - Wien 1938 und der Exodus der Mathematik], pp. 16  seq.</ref> Nöbeling worked and researched in Menger's Mathematical Colloquium with [[Kurt Gödel]], [[Franz Alt (mathematician)|Franz Alt]], [[Abraham Wald]], [[Olga Taussky-Todd]] and others.

In 1933, he moved to the [[University of Erlangen]], where he habilitated in 1935 under [[Otto Haupt]] and obtained a professorship at the same place in 1940. His work focused on [[Mathematical analysis|analysis]], [[topology]], and [[geometry]]. 1968/1969 he solved [[Ernst Specker|Specker]]'s theorem on [[abelian group]]s.

As [[Rector (academia)|Rector]] (1962–1963) of the University of Erlangen he oversaw the merge with the business college in [[Nuremberg]].<ref>Source: {{cite web |url=http://www.uni-erlangen.de/infocenter/presse/pressemitteilungen/2007/nachrichten_2007/11_07/263noebeling.shtml |title=Zum Geburtstag des Mathematikers Prof. Dr. Georg Nöbeling |accessdate=2007-11-10 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://archive.today/20130212064342/http://www.uni-erlangen.de/infocenter/presse/pressemitteilungen/2007/nachrichten_2007/11_07/263noebeling.shtml |archivedate=2013-02-12 }}</ref> He also served twice as the chairman of the [[German Mathematical Society]] and is a member of the [[Bavarian Academy of Sciences and Humanities]]. He celebrated his 100th birthday in 2007.<ref name=Geyer>{{cite press release|title =  Zum Geburtstag des Mathematikers Prof. Dr. Georg Nöbeling|publisher = Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg|date = 2008-01-14|language = German|url = http://www.presse.uni-erlangen.de/infocenter/presse/pressemitteilungen/2007/nachrichten_2007/11_07/263noebeling.shtml|accessdate = 2008-02-24}}</ref><ref>Wulf-Dieter Geyer: "[https://faubox.rrze.uni-erlangen.de/dl/fiMeTbcTm4yAzxwEEgsAv8pY Georg Nöbeling zum 100. Geburtstag]," ''Akademie Aktuell: Zeitschrift der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften'' [http://www.badw.de/aktuell/akademie_aktuell/2007/heft4/index.html No. 23 (04/2007)] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090110060757/http://www.badw.de/aktuell/akademie_aktuell/2007/heft4/index.html |date=2009-01-10 }}, 36–38.</ref>

== Publications (selected) ==
* Georg Nöbeling: "Über eine n-dimensionale Universalmenge im <math>\mathbb{R}^{2n+1}</math> (on a n-dimensional universal set for  metric spaces in <math>\mathbb{R}^{2n+1}</math>." ''Mathematische Annalen'' 104 (1931), pp.&nbsp;71–80.
* Georg Nöbeling: "Verallgemeinerung eines Satzes von E. Specker (Generalization of a Theorem by E. Specker)". ''Inventiones mathematicae'' 6 (1968), pp.&nbsp;41–55.
